name: Hierarchy SHIFT
description: Hierarchy SHIFT, a what-if prototype for controllers using SAP BW Live hierarchies in SAP Analytics Cloud. v0.8.4 fixes two high-priority workflow bugs: a normal SAC refresh now always starts from the fresh BW baseline instead of silently restoring the last transient SHIFT working scenario, and Graphical View drag-and-drop now auto-scrolls at all four workspace edges so nodes can be moved to distant hierarchy targets. Saved scenarios remain available and are applied only after an explicit Load action.

scenarioBookmarkState.description: Deprecated legacy state property. Since v0.8.4 the transient working scenario is not restored automatically. Use SHIFT Saved Scenarios and explicit Load instead.

scenarioSaved.description: Emitted when a local Hierarchy SHIFT scenario bookmark is saved.

scenarioLoaded.description: Emitted when a saved local Hierarchy SHIFT scenario bookmark is loaded.
